<ins>Blood-Breaking Pain-Dispersing Decoction (破血消痛湯)</ins>
Notopterygium (羌活), saposhnikovia (防風), cinnamon bark (官桂, each one qian), sappan wood (蘇木, one and a half qian), bupleurum (柴胡), forsythia (連翹), dang gui tip (當歸梢, each two qian), musk (麝香, ground separately, a little), leech (水蛭, stir-fried until the smoke is exhausted, ground separately, two qian)
Above, make into coarse powder, one dose in total; with two large cups of wine and one cup of water, grind the leech and musk separately into a paste, decoct the remaining medicines to one large cup, remove from the fire, take slightly warm, mixing in the two ingredients and taking; two doses bring immediate recovery. <ins>Heart-Clearing Medicine (清心藥)</ins>
Moutan bark (牡丹皮), dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), red peony (赤芍藥), raw rehmannia (生地黃), scutellaria (黃芩), coptis (黃連), forsythia (連翹), gardenia (梔子), peach kernel (桃仁), licorice (甘草, each equal parts)
Above, decoct with the guiding herbs juncus (燈心草) and mint (薄荷), add boy's urine and take together. <ins>Pain-Stopping Medicine (止痛藥)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸), achyranthes (牛膝), chuanxiong (川芎), Huaiqing raw rehmannia (懷慶生地), red peony (赤芍藥), angelica dahurica (白芷), notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), eucommia (杜仲), dipsacus (續斷, each one liang), cinnamon bark (肉桂), star anise (八角茴香), frankincense (乳香), myrrh (沒藥, each five qian), southern saussurea (南木香), dingpi (丁皮), agarwood (沉香), dragon's blood (血竭, each two and a half qian)
Above, grind into powder and mix with aged wine for use.
